pr_title: Properly disable comment box on things that cannot be commented on

issue_context.title: Comment field on maps with comment disabled can still be typed in
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

On such map: https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/919187#osu/1919312
The comment input field when inputted on browser is locked (image 1), but not when viewed on lazer (image 2). Trying to submit a comment like that will just prompt an error.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/17acb945-c67d-4c0e-9994-9848648bfc27)


### Version

2024.906.2

### Logs

[compressed-logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17181245/compressed-logs.zip)

review_comments: `Current` is the comment text in this context, and `updateState()` is now responsible for disabling the commit button, so I want this particular interaction to be instant.
